facts.fact: The decree of August 2024 cites loi n°015/2014 of 7 January 2015 instituting and organising the National Statistical System, as amended by loi n°016/2022 of 6 September 2022, as the legal basis it is taken under.
facts.system: Loi n°015/2014 portant institution et organisation du Système Statistique National (2015, amended 2022)

facts.fact: Décret n°0314/PR/MPP of 1 August 2024 (signed 2 August, published in Journal Officiel n°31 of 15 August 2024) approves the statutes of the Institut National de la Statistique, citing the statistics law among its legal bases.
facts.system: Loi n°015/2014 portant institution et organisation du Système Statistique National (2015, amended 2022)
